oneLine: Plans the trucks and flights between nodes, books each locked order's package on a pickup, and tracks loads from dispatch to arrival.

rows.title: Define a lane's weekly schedule
rows.story: A planner sets the weekly template of a lane: for each slot the cut-off, departure and arrival times and how many packages fit. Redefining replaces the slots; departures already planned stay.

rows.title: Retire a lane's schedule
rows.story: A planner retires the schedule of a lane. No new departures are planned from it; departures already planned are not cancelled.

rows.title: Keep two weeks of departures planned
rows.story: At start and then every interval, every active lane schedule is expanded into departures for the next 14 days. A rerun adds only what is missing.
rows.policy: Every interval, plan the departures missing from the next 14 days of every active schedule

then.does: adds the departure to its copy so promises can use it
adds the departure to the network copy its search uses

rows.title: Plan pickups when a vendor centre goes live
rows.story: A vendor-run centre gets a pickup departure for each of its declared cut-offs, over 14 days. Pickups are re-planned when its profile changes or a lane opens, whichever arrives last.
rows.policy: Whenever a centre is activated, revised or gets a lane, plan its pickups from its cut-offs

then.does: adds the pickup to its copy so promises can use it
adds the pickup to the network copy its search uses

rows.title: Stop pickups when a centre leaves service
rows.story: When a node is suspended or retired, its future pickups are cancelled, and every package booked on them is moved to the next pickup or reported as failed.
rows.policy: Whenever a node is suspended or retired, cancel its future pickups

then.does: flags promises whose route used the pickup as at risk
marks the pickup as cancelled in its network copy

rows.title: Cancel a departure
rows.story: A planner cancels a departure that has not left. Every package booked on it moves to the next pickup from the same origin, or the booking is reported as failed.

then.does: flags promises whose route used the departure as at risk
marks the departure as cancelled in its network copy

rows.title: Change a departure's capacity
rows.story: A planner resizes a departure that has not left. It cannot go below what is already booked.

then.does: updates the room left on its copy of the departure
updates the room left on its copy of the departure

rows.title: Book a package when the order locks
rows.story: When a group locks on a node, one package is booked on its pickup. If that pickup is full, closed or gone the booking moves to the next pickup, or fails. A merged package books only once.
rows.policy: Whenever a group locks, book one package on its pickup, or the next one, or report a failure

then.does: points the locked group at the new pickup; a failed booking changes nothing there
flags the promise as at risk and skips the departure that was left

rows.title: Keep the expected volume
rows.story: Each release tells linehaul which node and planned pickup a group is heading for. A reassignment or cancellation only updates this record; nothing is booked before the lock.
rows.policy: Whenever a group is released, reassigned or cancelled, update its expected volume record

rows.title: Keep the tracking numbers
rows.story: Shipping-and-tracking issues the labels. Linehaul keeps each tracking number on the group's record; a voided label removes its number but keeps the booking.
rows.policy: Whenever a label is issued or voided, add or remove its tracking number on the group's record

rows.title: Open a load on a departure
rows.story: An operator opens the load that will ride a departure that has not left. A departure has at most one load.

rows.title: Add a package to the load
rows.story: An operator scans a package onto an open load. A package can be on only one open load, and the load cannot exceed the departure's capacity. On a truck or flight (not a pickup) the package also takes a seat.

rows.title: Close the load
rows.story: An operator closes the load; the departure closes with it. No package can be added afterwards.

rows.title: Dispatch the load
rows.story: An operator sends a closed load on its way. The load and its departure are recorded as departed.

then.does: records a departure scan for each tracking number
starts timing the trip to measure real transit time

rows.title: Receive the load at its destination
rows.story: An operator receives a departed load at its destination. The load and its departure are recorded as arrived.

then.does: takes in each package when the load reaches a delivery station
records an arrival scan for each tracking number
completes the measured transit time and notes the arrival

hotspots.text: A booking that fails leaves the locked group without a seat. Order-sourcing only records it; delivery-promise flags the promise as at risk.
If order-sourcing cancels after the lock, the package stays booked on its departure until the departure leaves.
A closed lane cancels nothing: departures already planned on it stay until a planner cancels them by hand.
There is no metric for the unsent-event backlog, consumer lag or the horizon roll, and no alert on parked failed messages; they are read from the database and logs.
